patchNotes: Adds nine off-bike Smoke Session gestures with temporary props, corrected camera and bong orientation, visible smoke, and shared emote search and filters. The pack is embedded in the DLL. Fixes hidden-slot equip timeouts when reloading outfit presets and extra reference bodies showing through custom clothes. Release build, 401 automated checks, native audits, and local preset/gameplay checks passed. Gestures and props are local; multiplayer sync, replay recording, and pack audio are not included.
